summary: Frontend Coding Agent implemented the full production code for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). 8 files created: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema, types, validation), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, quota purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time crash detection with corruption handling), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand store bridging services to React), useAutoSave.ts (interval + beforeunload hook), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible dialog modal), AutoSaveStatus.tsx (save indicator), and ResumePrompt/index.ts (barrel export). All data-testid attributes added per E2E test contract. Implementation satisfies all 10 test cases from LLD Section 12.

artifacts.name: IndexedDB Schema & Types
artifacts.description: Database name, version, object store constants, all TypeScript interfaces (SceneSnapshot, AutoSaveMeta, RecoveryCandidate, BrickRecord, CameraState, SceneMetadata), PersistenceError class, openDB/closeDB functions, isValidSnapshot validator

artifacts.name: Persistence Service
artifacts.description: saveSnapshot() with atomic dual-store write, closeSession() to mark status=closed, loadSnapshot(), purgeSession(), quota exceeded purge-and-retry logic

artifacts.name: Crash Recovery Service
artifacts.description: detectCrash() scans for active sessions, validates snapshots, handles corruption (null bricks, schema mismatch), discardRecovery() purges session data

artifacts.name: Persistence Zustand Store
artifacts.description: Zustand store with autoSaveStatus, recoveryCandidate, triggerAutoSave, markSessionClosed, checkForCrashRecovery, acceptRecovery, discardRecoveryAction

artifacts.name: useAutoSave Hook
artifacts.description: Interval-based auto-save (5s default) + beforeunload listener for graceful close detection. Cleanup on unmount.

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Component
artifacts.description: Accessible dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby) with brick count, Resume/Discard buttons, all required data-testid attributes

artifacts.name: AutoSaveStatus Component
artifacts.description: Status indicator with data-testid=auto-save-status showing Saving.../Saved/Save failed
